Nadia R.: Postmortem follow-up: assigning owners for the recurring cache-thrashing items. I'll list brief tasks + suggested due dates. Claim or reassign here.

Evan C.: Thanks, Nadia. Post them.

Nadia R.: Task 1 — eviction telemetry + alert (Jira INFR-7321). Due in 5 business days. Needs dashboard, firing alert rule, and alert playbook link.

Evan C.: I'll take INFR-7321. Plan: add eviction-rate metric, Grafana panel, and a PagerDuty signal for sustained >5% over 10m.

Nadia R.: Add acceptance criteria: dashboard, alert, runbook link, and example noise-filter for deploys.

Evan C.: Will update ticket with that and a quick PR.

Nadia R.: Task 2 — background job throttling (INFR-7322). Due in 10 days. Concurrency cap + gradual rollout.

Liam H.: I can own INFR-7322. I'll implement `throttle_pct` config and a circuit-breaker. Will test on staging.

Priya S.: I'll own the runbook update (RUN-98). Short checklist + customer blurb. Due in 4 days.

Nadia R.: Please link RUN-98 to INFR-7321 and INFR-7322 and add a parent for cross-cutting work: INFR-7400.

ops-bot: Reminder set: Postmortem follow-up 1 2024-06-05 16:00 UTC.
